raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 14
, Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer introduced unverified “assumed” annual pass prices ($150 per adult, $75 per student) instead of looking up the Philadelphia Museum of Art’s actual membership pricing and structure. This incorrect assumption drove the annual total to $675 and led to the wrong conclusion (-$5), whereas correct pricing would yield the expected $395 savings.
